# Cross-situational

(this may be the target of the CogSci paper)

```{r}
# unique(xd$experiment_name)
# "Experiment 2"  - all completely unfamiliar items, but fewer (6 instead of 12) - no systematic choices for kids
# "Experiment 3"  - has mutual exclusivity trials
# "Experiment 1"  "Experiment S1" - have a randomly-selected XSL trial after selection?
# randomized trial order - so use subject-specific training 

xd_test <- xd %>% filter(trial_type=="test" | trial_type=="fam-test") %>% 
  mutate(correct = ifelse(choice_image==target_image, 1, 0))

xd_test %>% group_by(experiment_name, trial_type, age_group) %>%
  summarise(correct = mean(correct)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=age_group, y=correct, color=trial_type)) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ experiment_name) + 
  geom_point() + ylim(0,1)

xd_s <- xd %>% filter(subject=="Crossact1_p101")
table(xd_s$trial_type) # 29 trials
#  fam-learning fam-selection      fam-test      learning     selection          test 
#            4             2             4             9             4             6 

# let's just remove all fam- trials (training)


get_experiment_cooc_matrix <- function(dat, experiment_name) {
  xd_s <- subset(dat, experiment_name==experiment_name & subject==unique(dat$subject)[1])
  voc = sort(na.omit(unique(c(xd_s$label1, xd_s$label2))))
  refs = sort(na.omit(unique(unlist(xd_s %>% select(starts_with("image"))))))
  coocs <- matrix(0, nrow=length(voc), ncol=length(refs))
  row.names(coocs) = voc
  colnames(coocs) = refs
  return(coocs)
}


get_experiment_cooc_matrix(xd, "Experiment 1")
get_experiment_cooc_matrix(xd, "Experiment 2")
get_experiment_cooc_matrix(xd, "Experiment 3")
get_experiment_cooc_matrix(xd, "Experiment S1")

run_subject_trials <- function(xd_s) {
  coocs <- get_experiment_cooc_matrix(xd_s, xd_s[1,]$experiment_name)
  # iterate over trials, handle training and selection/test trials
  for(i in 1:nrow(xd_s)) {
    # should ignore 
    refs = setdiff(unlist(xd_s[i,] %>% select(starts_with("image"))), NA)
    labs = setdiff(unlist(xd_s[i,] %>% select(starts_with("label"))), NA)
    coocs[labs,refs] = coocs[labs,refs] + 1
  }
}

```
